title: The J. Paul Getty Museum

services.name: Tours
services.desc: Discover the Getty Center’s dynamic collections with your students as they explore centuries of European art, contemporary photography, and rotating exhibitions, surrounded by striking architecture and tranquil gardens. Immerse your students in the wonders of ancient Greece and Rome at the Getty Villa, where antiquity comes alive. Enjoy an interactive exploration of art, architecture, and storytelling in a beautifully reimagined Roman villa surrounded by lush gardens and ocean views. Each year, the Getty Museum offers engaging field trips that spark curiosity and deepen engagement with art for K-12 students in person and online.
